papers.title: VC-Attention: Value Smoothing and Softmax Casting for Low-bit Attention
papers.desc: Diffusion Transformers deliver state-of-the-art video generation, but their long spatiotemporal sequences make attention the dominant deployment cost, and a deployable low-bit kernel must be accurate and fast.

papers.title: FLAT: Resampling Image and Text into 1D Flexible-Length Aligned Transmodal Tokens for Retrieval and Generation
papers.desc: Traditional multimodal representation learning and generation are two stages: a contrastive or self-supervised visual encoder is trained first, followed by a separate downstream generative model.

papers.title: Mind2Dialogue: Training Human-Aware Language Models by Simulating User Mental States
papers.desc: As language models become more capable, long-term collaboration in learning, reasoning, and decision-making calls for a deeper understanding of the people they serve.

papers.title: Flattening Every Memory Peak in Long-Context Mixture-of-Experts Training
papers.desc: Training a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model at long context or large batch size fails as soon as any one component's peak allocation exceeds device memory, so the target is every peak at once, not the average footprint.

papers.title: Agora: Git as Shared Memory for Collective AutoResearch
papers.desc: Autonomous research loops such as AutoResearch show that one coding agent can improve a training setup unattended.

papers.title: Generalized Agent Iteration: One Formal Framework for Iterative Policy Improvement and Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.desc: When we speak of recursive self-improvement (RSI), are we speaking of a phenomenon, a mechanism, or a prospect?

papers.title: HypoEvolve: Genetic Algorithms Enable Multi-Agent LLMs to Discover Scientific Hypotheses
papers.desc: Scientific agents contribute to hypothesis discovery by synthesizing evidence, assessing proposals, and developing new explanations.

papers.title: Gaze as Evidence for Common Grounding: A Cross-Corpus Analysis of MapTask and MUNDEX
papers.desc: In collaborative tasks with asymmetric information, participants coordinate their understanding through interaction.

papers.title: HarnessVLN: Unifying Training-Free Embodied Navigation through an Agent Harness
papers.desc: Embodied navigation requires agents to interpret visual observations, accumulate spatial knowledge, and execute actions to follow instructions or locate objects.

papers.title: Modality-Autoregressive World-Action Models
papers.desc: World-action models (WAMs) jointly model future observations and actions, typically predicting the future as RGB images.

arxiv.title: Using OCR Heads to Verbalize Image Semantics
arxiv.desc: How do VLMs map from pixels to semantics?

arxiv.title: On-the-Fly Homographies Calibration for Multi-Camera Tracking
arxiv.desc: Precise multi-camera tracking traditionally relies on rigorous 3D site calibration, yet this requirement is often operationally impossible in large-scale deployments.

arxiv.title: PhysVGGT: Feed-Forward Dense Physical Property Estimation from A Single Image
arxiv.desc: Physical properties, such as friction, hardness, stiffness, and density, govern how robots should grasp, manipulate and interact with objects, yet estimating these properties from RGB images remains challenging.

arxiv.title: HAP: A Hand-Driven Active Perception Framework for Egocentric Head Motion Prediction
arxiv.desc: Egocentric motion forecasting has primarily focused on hands and manipulated objects, leaving future human head motion comparatively underexplored.

arxiv.title: DiT-Garment: Garment Dynamics with Diffusion Transformers
arxiv.desc: We present DiT-Garment to model dynamic 3D clothing over human body models in arbitrary motion.

arxiv.title: InterMASH: A Unified Geometric Representation for Grasp Synthesis
arxiv.desc: Grasp synthesis aims to generate stable and physically plausible hand--object interactions, and has become a fundamental problem in both human hand modeling and robotic manipulation.

arxiv.title: GeoCond: A Conditioning-Aware Reliability Adapter for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
arxiv.desc: Feed-forward 3D foundation models such as VGGT predict cameras, depth, and point maps in a single pass, but can fail silently under low overlap, low parallax, and extreme relative rotation.

arxiv.title: NormLift: From Lifted Features To Semantic Reliability In 3D Gaussian Splatting
arxiv.desc: Training-free weighted aggregation is widely used to lift 2D semantic features onto 3D Gaussians for open-vocabulary scene understanding, yet its theoretical role remains insufficiently understood.
